title: Inheritance and Autopsy
author: Tamsin Voss
blurb: Wren Coldharbour, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
